_comment: Label policy used by validate_labels.py. 'agent' labels mirror safe-outputs.add-labels.allowed in .github/workflows/issue-triage.md; the workflow allowlist is the hard limit, this file is the procedural check. Existing upstream labels keep their upstream colour.

type:bug.description: Something is not working as expected

type:docs.description: Documentation or a question that may improve the docs

need more information.description: Reporter must add details before a maintainer can act

triage:possible-duplicate.description: Bot suggestion: may duplicate an earlier issue (maintainer confirms)

triage:support-question.description: Bot suggestion: usage/support question, better asked on Discord or Stack Exchange

triage:possible-spam.description: Bot suggestion: spam, scam, phishing, promotion or an untouched template

triage:security-report.description: Bot suggestion: may describe a vulnerability; see SECURITY.md

triage-agent:halt.description: KILL SWITCH: while any open issue has this label the triage agent does not run or write

slop.description: Maintainer judgement about low-effort AI content; never applied by the bot
